title: Midring settle spot quality: when P29 has already decided to settle, pick between 2-3 reachable midring spots by cover, escape-route clearance and zone slack (MIDRING_SPOT_ON)
behaviors: Only inside the existing P29 settle branch (brain.ts ~848-869: mode hold, farmOk, afterShrink, r > MIDRING_MIN_R, no near-and-reachable drop). Instead of the single goal at MIDRING_GOAL*r on our own side, score up to 3 reachable candidates inside MIDRING_LO..MIDRING_HI by static building/trunk cover near the spot, open exit directions on the nav grid, and slack to the next zone. P29 trigger, drop yields, timing and MIDRING_STUCK_S give-up unchanged. No patrol, no wider search, no omniscient inputs.
source: Doug research handoff 2026-11-21 ~9:16 PM ET, option R1 (spatial quality, not radius); selected by coordinator 9:2x PM ET

evidence.parent_win: P29 midring settle 4.17 -> 4.35 on site (BB-BAB3F961), the largest recent single-change gain; P34 4.38 is built on it.
evidence.watcher: coord/data/watcher RANKED #4/#8: top teams are stuck far less with 5-8 and 2-4 alive (14% vs 41%, 11% vs 31%); cover.md: winners hold next to buildings/LOS more than open ground (first-pass, correlation only).
evidence.trees: Trees-on sim now matches the live map byte for byte (1,560 trees, 259 prisms), so cover near a spot is measurable in the sim.
evidence.not_proof: None of this shows the change raises site score.

non_overlap: Not P29 (radius/trigger unchanged), not P29b (retired gate fix), not SKILLS-2 (retired patrol), not P24/HEAL_COVER1 (heal under cover, lost 3.79), not P40b (roof route). Laser options (R3) skipped because P34b2, P42 and P44 already cover the P34 follow-ups.
step_a: On main 588557e, trees-on, bases 2000-5000 (192+192 games), log-only (no behavior change): count settle starts, how often 2+ reachable candidates in the band differ in a cover/exit proxy, time stuck while settled, deaths within 20 s of a settle. Pass: such choices exist in >= 10/192 games on BOTH sets and decision time stays under 30 ms worst case. Fail or rare: stop with a one-line reason in this record.
failure_conditions: new 20 s+ pauses under the stall rule
next_action: Mech Builder: Step A in the next free session (ahead of P37b). If it passes, build one flag on main, flag-off byte-identical, 4-base trees-on checklist, archive < 15,000,000, then full paired screen by Sim Tester before any site test.
approval_requirements: None new: Step A and the build follow the existing workflow. Site test only after a full passing screen, submitted by the loop. Any exception or rule change needs Doug's yes.
